oneLiner: Weekly meal plans built from the ingredients you already have.
problem: Households waste food and waste time figuring meals because they don't know what’s already in the fridge and lack an easy way to plan around it.
targetUser: Busy adults, families, and health‑conscious cooks who want to reduce waste and simplify dinner planning.
coreFlow: User opens the app and lands on the dashboard
User adds or scans current fridge items in the Inventory screen
User selects dietary preferences and constraints
App generates a week‑long meal plan using only available ingredients
User reviews recipes, adjusts meals, and exports a shopping list or printable plan

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Welcome screen that shows a quick summary of inventory status and a call‑to‑action to start planning.

screens.name: Inventory Input
screens.purpose: Add, edit, or delete fridge items via manual entry, barcode scan, or bulk upload.

screens.name: Preferences
screens.purpose: Set dietary filters (e.g., vegetarian, low‑carb) and portion preferences.

screens.name: Meal Plan
screens.purpose: Weekly calendar view displaying generated meals, with quick swap options.

screens.name: Recipe Detail
screens.purpose: Step‑by‑step cooking instructions, ingredient breakdown, and nutritional snapshot.

outOfScope: AI‑generated recipes that require new ingredients
